headline: Israeli Strikes Eliminate Key Hamas, PIJ Commanders in Gaza Escalation
subheadline: IDF confirms deaths of Army of Islam operative and Hamas Jabalia Battalion commander amid ongoing regional tensions.
lede: Israeli airstrikes in Gaza eliminated three senior terror operatives including Hamas Jabalia Battalion commander Ahmad Khudar, while Hezbollah-linked IEDs wounded five Lebanese soldiers in Kafra. The IDF denied involvement in the Kafra incident, attributing it to Hezbollah. British maritime authorities reported an explosion in the Strait of Hormuz as Iran-Oman negotiations reached final stages, with IRGC maintaining the strait's closure. Russian missile attacks hit Ukrainian infrastructure with a record 376 launches in July, targeting Kyiv and triggering chemical spills in Poltava.

sections.title: Russian Missile Barrage Hits Ukrainian Infrastructure
sections.body: Russian forces launched a record 376 missiles in July, striking Kyiv and targeting Zaporižhzhia's private sector where one civilian died. Ukrainian air defenses intercepted over 90% of incoming Shahed and Lancet drones. Reactionary drones from Mykolaiv and Kharkiv targeted ports and logistics hubs. A chemical spill occurred in Poltava following Russian strikes on infrastructure.

sections.title: Israeli Operations Expand Across Gaza and Lebanon
sections.body: Israeli strikes killed three terror operatives in Gaza including Hamas Jabalia Battalion commander Ahmad Khudar. Five Lebanese soldiers were wounded by an IED in Kafra, which the IDF attributed to Hezbollah rather than Israeli involvement. An explosion damaged a vessel in the Strait of Hormuz as Iran-Oman talks concluded final stages, with IRGC denying any reopening agreement.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: Escalation patterns show coordinated multi-theater operations with Israeli strikes eliminating key Hamas commanders while Hezbollah-Iranian proxy forces test Israeli vulnerabilities. Russian infrastructure targeting has intensified with record missile usage and expansion into civilian economic targets, raising concerns about broader destabilization in both conflict zones.
